question: A man walks at a speed of sqrt{x} km/hr. After 2 hours, he has covered the same number of kilometers as the value of x. What is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Logic: Distance = Speed × Time

Given: Speed = √x, Time = 2, Distance = x

x = 2 × √x ⇒ √x = 2

Squaring both sides: x = 2² = 4

**∴ Answer = 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the man = √x km/hr

Time taken = 2 hours

Distance covered = x km

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
• Start End Speed = √x km/hr Time = 2 hr 
• Distance = x km 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ x = √x × 2

⇒ x / √x = 2

⇒ √x = 2

⇒ x = 2²

⇒ x = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 (Option 1).**
